title: How Fair is Fair Trade?
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.translation: 早期用來回應已發展世界和發展中世界不平衡問題的口號是甚麼？

blocks.text: 題目問：
“What was an early slogan about addressing the imbalance between the developed and developing worlds?”
Short-answer question
限制：NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 2。首句提到 1950s and 1960s、developed world、developed and developing countries 的 disparities。末句提到 these days, much fair trade does include aid。首尾句已經顯示，本段是在講公平貿易早期理念和後來轉變，所以 slogan 很可能在這段中間。
用題目詞定位
最有定位力的字是 “early slogan” 和 “imbalance”。文章沒有用 imbalance，但有 “enormous disparities”，意思是巨大差距。掃描 Paragraph 2，可找到：
“The catchphrase ‘Trade Not Aid’ was used by church groups and trade unions—early supporters of fair trade…”
中文意思：
「Trade Not Aid」這個口號由教會團體和工會使用；它們是公平貿易的早期支持者。
細讀答案
題目問 “What was an early slogan”，原文用 “catchphrase”，即口號、流行標語。題目說addressing the imbalance，原文前一句講 “enormous disparities”，即發展程度和貿易機會上的巨大差距。兩者意思對應。
early slogan = catchphrase imbalance = enormous disparities early supporters = church groups and trade unions答案必須直接抄原文，且不超過三個字，所以答案是 Trade Not Aid。

questions.translation: 最廣為人知的公平貿易商品大概是甚麼？

blocks.text: 題目問：
“What is probably the best-known fair-trade commodity?”
Short-answer question
限制：NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 3。這段只有一句：

“Tea, coffee, cocoa, cotton, flowers, handicrafts, and gold are all major fair-trade items, with coffee being the most recognizable, found on supermarket shelves and at café chains throughout the developed world.”
中文意思：
茶、咖啡、可可、棉花、鮮花、手工藝品和黃金都是主要公平貿易商品，其中咖啡最容易被認出，在已發展世界的超市貨架和連鎖咖啡店都可找到。
只看這句，段落功能非常清楚：列舉公平貿易商品，並指出最具代表性的商品。
用題目詞定位
題目關鍵詞是 “best-known” 和 “commodity”。原文沒有用 best-known，而是用 “most recognizable”。commodity 對應 “items”。
細讀答案
原文說 “with coffee being the most recognizable”。most recognizable 即最容易辨認、最廣為人知。題目問 probably the best-known fair-trade commodity，答案就是 coffee。
best-known = most recognizable commodity = item fair-trade = fair-trade
答案：coffee

questions.translation: 根據作者，相對於全球總貿易而言，公平貿易生產者代表甚麼？

blocks.text: 題目問：
“According to the writer, what do fair-trade producers represent in relation to total global trade?”
Short-answer question
限制：NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 4。首句說 around two million farmers and workers 生產公平貿易產品，但這相對 total global trade 是 tiny number。末句說批評者認為如果這些人回到主流貿易系統，會收到更高價格。首尾句顯示本段在比較公平貿易的規模和爭議。
用題目詞定位
最強定位詞是 “total global trade”。原文第一句直接出現同一組字：
“Although around two million farmers and workers produce fair-trade items, this is a tiny number in relation to total global trade.”
中文意思：
雖然大約二百萬農民和工人生產公平貿易商品，但相對於全球總貿易而言，這只是一個很小的數字。
細讀答案
題目問 “what do fair-trade producers represent”，原文的 “this” 指前面的 around two million farmers and workers。作者評價這個數量為 “a tiny number”。
答案形式要保留冠詞 a，因為原文短語是 “a tiny number”，剛好三個字，符合字數限制。
答案：a tiny number

questions.translation: 支持者認為公平貿易如何影響了很多人？

blocks.text: 題目問：
“How do supporters think fair trade has affected many people?”
Short-answer question
限制：NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 4。首句說公平貿易生產者在全球總貿易中只是小數；末句說批評者認為回到 mainstream trading system 會有較高價格。這段夾在中間的重點會自然呈現兩種立場： advocates 和 critics。
用題目詞定位
題目詞 “supporters” 在原文中改寫為 “fair-trade advocates”。“affected many people” 對應原文
“impact on many more people worldwide”。原文句子：“Still, fair-trade advocates maintain that the system has had a positive impact on many more people worldwide…”
中文意思：
不過，公平貿易支持者堅持認為，這個系統對全球更多人產生了正面影響。
細讀答案
題目問 how fair trade has affected many people。原文答案是 “has had a positive impact”。因為答案最多三個字，不能填 “has had a positive impact”，所以應抽取核心名詞短語 “positive impact”。
supporters = advocates affected = had an impact on many people = many more people worldwide
答案：positive impact

questions.translation: 批評者認為，如果公平貿易生產者回到主流貿易，他們會收到甚麼？

blocks.text: 題目問：
“What do critics think fair-trade producers would receive if they returned to mainstream trade?”
Short-answer question
限制：NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 4。首句處理公平貿易規模小，末句直接講 critics 對 mainstream trading system 的看法。題目有 critics 和 mainstream trade，與末句高度吻合。
用題目詞定位
定位詞是 “critics”、“returned” 和 “mainstream trade”。原文末句出現：
“…while the critics claim that if those two million returned to the mainstream trading system, they would receive higher prices for their goods or labour.”
中文意思：
批評者則聲稱，如果那二百萬人回到主流貿易系統，他們的貨品或勞動會得到更高價格。
細讀答案
題目問 would receive what。原文動詞也是 “would receive”，答案短語在後面：“higher prices”。
“for their goods or labour” 解釋價格針對貨品或勞動，但題目只問收到甚麼，所以填 higher prices已足夠。
critics = critics returned to mainstream trade = returned to the mainstream trading system receive = receive answer = higher prices
答案：higher prices
Questions 20–23

questions.answer: D — to pay more for products they regard as ethical.
questions.answerKey: D — to pay more for products they regard as ethical.
questions.prompt: “Consumers of fair-trade products are willing to pay more for products they regard as ethical.”
questions.translation: 公平貿易產品的消費者願意為他們認為合乎道德的產品多付一點錢。

blocks.text: Sentence endings
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 5。首句說公平貿易 supposed to be fair to producers。末句說少數非公平貿易農民採納相關做法，但不少人視之為 rich-world conceits。首尾句顯示這段先講制度原則，後講生產者義務和外界反應。
用題目詞定位
題目主體是 “Consumers of fair-trade products”，原文對應 “developed-world consumers”。題目動詞是 “are willing”，原文意思對應 “will pay slightly more”。
原文句子：
“Its basic tenet is that developed-world consumers will pay slightly more for end products in the knowledge that developing-world producers have been equitably remunerated…”
中文意思：
它的基本信念是：已發展世界的消費者會為最終產品稍微多付一點，因為他們知道發展中世界的生產者已獲得公平報酬。
細讀答案
選項 D 的 “to pay more” 對應 “will pay slightly more”。“products they regard as ethical” 對應原文中消費者知道生產者得到公平報酬、產品在 decent circumstances 下製成。ethical 是概括詞，表示這些消費者認為購買行為合乎道德。
其他選項問題較大：A 講 loans or training，對應制度支援，不接 “consumers are willing”。B 講法律義務，對應生產者標準。D 在文法和意思上都最完整。

questions.answer: A — loans or training for producers and employees.
questions.answerKey: A — loans or training for producers and employees.
questions.prompt: “The fair-trade system may include loans or training for producers and employees.”
questions.translation: 公平貿易制度可能包括給生產者和員工的貸款或培訓。

blocks.text: Sentence endings
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 5。首句定義公平貿易應公平對待 producers。末句指出少數非公平貿易農民採納某些做法，但很多人視之為已發展世界的想法。段落中間自然會列出公平貿易制度包含甚麼。
用題目詞定位
題目詞是 “may include”。原文中對應的是 “may assist with”。再找 loans / training 的同義詞，會看到 “crop pre-financing” 和 “training”。
原文句子：
“Lastly, purchasers of fair-trade products may assist with crop pre-financing or with the training of producers and workers…”
中文意思：
最後，公平貿易產品的購買者可能協助作物預先融資，或協助生產者和工人的培訓。
細讀答案
A 的 “loans” 對應 “crop pre-financing”。pre-financing 指在作物收成或出售前先提供資金，功能上等同貸款或預支資金。A 的 “training for producers and employees” 對應 “training of producers and workers”。workers 可改寫為 employees。
may include = may assist with loans = crop pre-financing employees = workers所以答案是 A。

questions.answer: H — have been adopted by non-fair-trade producers.
questions.answerKey: H — have been adopted by non-fair-trade producers.
questions.prompt: “Some fair-trade practices have been adopted by non-fair-trade producers.”
questions.translation: 某些公平貿易做法已被非公平貿易生產者採用。

blocks.text: Sentence endings
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 5。這段先講公平貿易的價格和支援安排，後面講公平貿易生產者要遵守的勞工、人權、安全和環境要求。題目提到 “fair-trade practices”，所以要看段落中關於 practices 的句子。
用題目詞定位
題目詞是 “Some fair-trade practices”。原文出現非常接近的 “some fair-trade farming practices”。
原文句子：
“Research has shown that non-fair-trade farmers copy some fair-trade farming practices and occasionally encourage social progress.”
中文意思：
研究顯示，非公平貿易農民會仿效某些公平貿易農業做法，並偶爾推動社會進步。
細讀答案

“copy” 是答案核心。非公平貿易農民 copy 某些公平貿易 farming practices，即他們採用了、仿效了這些做法。選項 H 的 “have been adopted by non-fair-trade producers” 正是把主動句改成被動句。句法轉換：原文：non-fair-trade farmers copy some fair-trade farming practices選項：some fair-trade practices have been adopted by non-fair-trade producers farmers 和 producers 都指生產者；copy 和 adopted 在這裡都是採用、仿效。E “have influenced non-fair-trade producers” 有概括味道，但 H 更直接保留原文的 “copy” 關係，因此是最佳答案。

questions.answer: B — although they may not be obliged to do so in their own countries.
questions.answerKey: B — although they may not be obliged to do so in their own countries.
questions.prompt: “Fair-trade producers must adopt international employment standards although they may not be obliged to do so in their own countries.”
questions.translation: 公平貿易生產者必須採納國際勞工標準，即使在他們自己的國家未必有法律要求他們這樣做。

blocks.text: Sentence endings
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 5。首句講公平貿易應公平對待 producers；末句講非公平貿易農民對一些要求的抗拒。這段後半正好講 fair-trade producers 要遵守的標準。
用題目詞定位
題目詞是 “must adopt international employment standards”。原文沒有 employment standards這個完整短語，但列出 child or slave labour、United Nations Charter on Human Rights、safe workplaces、protect the environment 等要求。
原文句子：

“In exchange for ethical purchasing and other assistance, fair-trade producers agree not to use child or slave labour, to adhere to the United Nations Charter on Human Rights, to provide safe workplaces, and to protect the environment even when these requirements are not legally binding in their own countries.”
中文意思：
作為道德採購和其他協助的交換，公平貿易生產者同意不使用童工或奴隸勞工、遵守《聯合國人權憲章》、提供安全工作場所，並保護環境，即使這些要求在他們自己的國家沒有法律約束力。
細讀答案

B 的 “although they may not be obliged to do so in their own countries” 對應原文 “even when these requirements are not legally binding in their own countries”。not legally binding = 沒有法律約束力；may not be obliged = 未必有義務。
F 是中伏位。原文提到 United Nations Charter，但沒有說這些標準是因為 United Nations obligations 才要遵守。真正控制答案的是 “even when these requirements are not legally binding”。
Questions 24–27

questions.prompt: “The fair-trade system assists farmers who are extremely poor.”
questions.translation: 公平貿易制度幫助極度貧窮的農民。

blocks.text: YES / NO / NOT GIVEN
任務：判斷題目是否符合 writer’s claims。
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 7。首句說 “While fair trade is increasing, the system is far from perfect.”末句說有時公平貿易生產者收到的價格低於 open market，利潤常被公司拿走。首尾句顯示本段集中批評公平貿易制度的缺陷。
用題目詞定位
題目詞是 “farmers who are extremely poor”。原文中最接近的是 “the desperately poor”。
原文句子：

“First and foremost, there are expenses involved in becoming a fair-trade-certified producer, meaning the desperately poor rarely participate, so the very farmers fair-trade advocates originally hoped to support are excluded.”
中文意思：
最重要的是，成為公平貿易認證生產者需要費用，這意味著極度貧窮者很少能參與，因此那些公平貿易支持者原本希望幫助的農民反被排除在外。
細讀判斷
題目說 assists farmers who are extremely poor。原文說 the desperately poor rarely participate，並且 are excluded。這是清楚的相反方向。
命題比較：題目主體：fair-trade system題目動作：assists題目對象：extremely poor farmers原文主體：certification expenses原文結果：desperately poor rarely participate / are excluded
extremely poor = desperately poor assists = supports / helps are excluded = cannot participate / are left out原文指出他們很少能參與，這和 “assists” 衝突，所以答案是 NO。

questions.prompt: “Some products labelled as fair trade are not actually fair-trade products.”
questions.translation: 有些標示為公平貿易的產品，其實並非真正的公平貿易產品。

blocks.text: YES / NO / NOT GIVEN
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 7。首句說公平貿易制度 far from perfect。這提示後面會列出制度問題。題目提到 labelled as fair trade，所以要找 labelling、mislabel、monitoring 一類字眼。
用題目詞定位
題目定位詞是 “labelled as fair trade” 和 “not actually”。原文有 “mislabel” 和 “nothing of the kind”。
原文句子：

“Secondly, because conforming to the standards of fair-trade certification is costly, some producers deliberately mislabel their goods. The fair-trade monitoring process is patchy, and unfortunately, around 12% of fair-trade-labelled produce is nothing of the kind.”
中文意思：
第二，由於符合公平貿易認證標準成本高，有些生產者故意把貨品錯誤標示。公平貿易監察過程並不完善；不幸的是，大約 12% 標示為公平貿易的農產品完全不是那回事。
細讀判斷
題目說 some products labelled as fair trade are not actually fair-trade products。原文說 around 12% of fair-trade-labelled produce is nothing of the kind。nothing of the kind 意思是完全不是那類東西，也就是並非真正公平貿易產品。
Some products = around 12% of produce labelled as fair trade = fair-trade-labelled not actually fair-trade products = nothing of the kind題目和原文方向一致，所以答案是 YES。

questions.prompt: “UK supermarkets and cafés should not charge such high prices for fair-trade items.”
questions.translation: 英國超市和咖啡店不應該對公平貿易商品收取這麼高的價格。

blocks.text: YES / NO / NOT GIVEN
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 8。首句說 developed-world part 也有問題；末句說有些批評把公平貿易視為 marketing scam，但作者認為這種批評 may be overblown。這段會涉及已發展世界的零售、包裝、咖啡店和消費者問題。
用題目詞定位
題目詞是 “UK supermarkets and cafés”、“charge high prices”。原文沒有 UK supermarkets，但有 “One UK café chain” 和 “packers and retailers charge high prices”。
原文句子：
“In richer parts of the developed world, notably in London, packers and retailers charge high prices for fair-trade products.”
中文意思：
在已發展世界較富裕的地區，尤其是倫敦，包裝商和零售商對公平貿易產品收取高價。
再看：
“Consumers imagine they are paying so much because more money is returned to producers when profit-taking by retailers or packers is a more likely scenario.”
中文意思：
消費者以為自己付這麼多錢，是因為更多錢回到生產者手中；但更可能的情況是零售商或包裝商在獲取利潤。
細讀判斷
原文確實說 London 的 packers and retailers charge high prices，也說 consumers 可能誤以為高價會回到 producers。可是題目加入 “should not charge”。這是一個規範性判斷，意思是作者明確主張他們不應該這樣收費。
文章有批評語氣，但沒有直接說 UK supermarkets and cafés should not charge such high prices。它描述現象、指出消費者可能天真、給出咖啡連鎖店只把少量額外收費交給 producers 的例子。
這些資料可以支持「高價存在」和「高價未必惠及生產者」，但仍未提供題目所需的 should not。
所以答案是 NOT GIVEN。
學生很容易看到 “charge high prices” 就選 YES。但 YES 需要題目整個命題都被支持。這題真正缺少的是 “should not” 這個作者明確立場。

questions.prompt: “Fair trade is mainly a marketing ploy rather than a valid way of helping the poor.”
questions.translation: 公平貿易主要是一種市場營銷手段，並非幫助窮人的有效方式。

blocks.text: YES / NO / NOT GIVEN
先看段落功能

目標段落：Paragraph 8。首句說 developed-world part 也有問題，末句說一些批評者認為整個制度是 colossal marketing scam，但作者補充 this criticism may be overblown，因為 fair trade has endured and been praised in the developing world itself。這段最後一句直接控制作者態度。
用題目詞定位
題目詞是 “marketing ploy” 和 “valid way of helping the poor”。原文有非常接近的 “colossal marketing scam” 和 “assist the genuinely poor”。
原文句子：

“Other critics find the entire fair-trade system flawed—nothing more than a colossal marketing scam—and they would rather assist the genuinely poor in more transparent ways, but this criticism may be overblown since fair trade has endured and been praised in the developing world itself.”
中文意思：
另一些批評者認為整個公平貿易制度有缺陷，只是一場巨大的市場營銷騙局；他們寧願用更透明的方法幫助真正貧窮的人。不過，這種批評可能被誇大了，因為公平貿易一直存在，而且在發展中世界本身也受到讚揚。
細讀判斷
題目把 critics 的看法寫成一個整體判斷：Fair trade is mainly a marketing ploy。可是原文最後用
“but this criticism may be overblown” 明確削弱這種看法。作者承認有批評存在，也承認制度有問題，但沒有接受「公平貿易主要只是 marketing scam」這個結論。命題比較：
題目：fair trade is mainly a marketing ploy

原文：some critics say it is a colossal marketing scam作者態度：this criticism may be overblown支持原因：fair trade has endured and been praised in the developing world itself因此，題目把批評者觀點當成作者立場。作者反而指出這種批評可能過火，所以答案是 NO。
“colossal marketing scam” 和 “marketing ploy” 意思很接近，表面上非常吸引。但 IELTS YES /NO / NOT GIVEN 要分清誰在說話。這句先是 critics 的觀點，後面 “but this criticism may be overblown” 才顯示作者自己的判斷。

paragraphOverview.title: Skim Roadmap：全文段落地圖
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: 首句直接交代 fair-trade movement 的起點：戰後歐洲開始，近二十五年才擴展到六十多個國家的生產者和消費者。只看這句，可先估計本段功能是「介紹公平貿易的歷史起點和全球化發展」。本段很短，沒有進入具體爭議、價格或制度細節。它主要提供大背景，幫讀者知道文章不是只談某一種商品，也不是只談某一個國家，而是談一場跨國貿易運動的形成。

首句把時間推到 1950s and 1960s，指出 developed world 很多人關心 developed and developing countries 之間的巨大差距，也認為國際貿易制度排斥弱勢生產者。末句說今日很多公平貿易也包含 aid，例如志願者服務和免費培訓。只看首尾句，可見本段由早期理念走向後來變化：起初強調 “Trade Not Aid”，抗拒傳統援助；後來公平貿易又吸收了某些援助形式。Questions 15的 slogan 很可能在這段。

首句也是全段唯一一句，列出 tea, coffee, cocoa, cotton, flowers, handicrafts, gold 等主要fair-trade items，最後特別說 coffee 是最 recognizable，出現在 developed world 的超市和連鎖咖啡店。只看這句可立即知道本段功能：提供公平貿易商品例子，並突出 coffee 的代表性。這段不處理制度、公平性或批評，只回答「公平貿易包括甚麼商品」以及「哪一種最容易被消費者認出」。 Question 16 很可能定位在這裡。

首句說大約 two million farmers and workers 生產公平貿易產品，但相對 total global trade 只是tiny number。末句轉向 critics，說如果這些人生產者回到 mainstream trading system，他們可能得到 higher prices。只看首尾句，可先看見這段是「規模與爭議」段：支持者認為公平貿易有廣泛正面影響；批評者認為參與者未必得益更多。Questions 17–19 都集中在這段，因為題目詞包括total global trade、supporters、critics。

首句定義公平貿易：它 supposed to be a system of trade that is fair to producers。末句指出 few non-fair-trade farmers 採納某些公平貿易做法，因為他們把這些看成 rich-world conceits。只看首尾句，可估計本段是制度核心段：先講消費者願意多付錢、最低價格、community premium、pre-financing、training；後面講公平貿易生產者要遵守勞工、人權、安全和環境標準。Questions 20–23 的句尾配對主要在這段。

首句說為了讓消費者知道哪些商品在公平貿易條件下製成，goods are labelled。末句說現在有一個 European and American umbrella organisation 負責 labelling, standardisation, inspection。只看首尾句，可見本段功能很單一：說明公平貿易如何透過標籤和監督系統讓消費者辨認產品。這段沒有直接回答 Questions 15–27 的大部分題目，但它幫助理解後文批評，因為 Paragraph 7 會談 certification、mislabel 和 monitoring 的問題。

首句先轉折：公平貿易雖然增加，但系統 far from perfect。末句說有時公平貿易生產者收到的價格低於 open market，利潤常被 corporate firms 拿走。只看首尾句，可見本段集中批評 producer side 的問題：認證費用排斥 desperately poor、有人 mislabel、真正公平貿易產品未必能以公平貿易賣出、成本與收入關係不清、利潤分配不一定公平。Questions 24–25 直接來自這段。

首句說 developed-world part of the equation 也有問題。末句說一些批評者把整個制度視為colossal marketing scam，但這個批評 may be overblown，因為公平貿易持續存在，也在發展中國家獲得讚揚。只看首尾句，可見本段處理消費端和零售端問題：志願者可能幫到中間商、logo費用昂貴、marketing 成本高、倫敦等地零售價偏高、生產者未必得到相應增加。Questions 26–27需要細讀作者態度。
